اقتلعا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَلَعَا (iqtalaʕā) /iq.ta.la.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# اُقْتُلِعَا (uqtuliʕā) /uq.tu.li.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# اِقْتَلِعَا (iqtaliʕā) /iq.ta.li.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
